title: Reduced scalar-radion-flux-metric mixing and heavy-exchange audit
quadratic_action: L2=-1/2 dPhi^T K dPhi-1/2 Phi^T M2 Phi

decoupled.interpretation: exact reduced control with a pure massless Theta direction and no induced geometric operator

mild.interpretation: small kinetic and mass mixing plus small heavy vertices

generic.interpretation: order-one geometric vertices and a generic direct quartic; expected to fail the 0.8 Wilson-coefficient gate

protected.interpretation: all dangerous heavy vertices and direct quartic set to zero as an explicit symmetry input

secured_results.kinetic_gate: K must be positive definite before any physical interpretation
secured_results.tachyon_gate: all eigenvalues of the canonically normalized mass matrix must be nonnegative
secured_results.source_identity: the light eigenvector must be predominantly Theta for the imported baryogenesis source interpretation
secured_results.generic_exchange: nonzero radion, flux or metric heavy vertices generically induce an effective operator even when the pure scalar C00n selection rule holds
secured_results.protected_case: a passing reduced benchmark requires the dangerous vertices and direct quartic to be forbidden, not merely numerically set small

limitations: matrix elements are benchmark inputs rather than derived from the COS-02.2B parent background
the heavy-exchange indicator is reduced and not a complete dimensionful Wilson coefficient
tensor, vector, brane-bending and higher KK sectors are omitted
gauge fixing and constraint elimination of the full 6D perturbation system are not implemented
no evidence effect; K1-D and K1-E remain closed
